fusions.name: Pinning Pounce
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles onto the target. The landing deals 13 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Worried Prey
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. A weapon strike deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly to the Ground
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sheathed Until Needed
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
